author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swinging beat, finding a special note, echoing skipping patterns and taking turns, with an old circle-and-shake game.

classes.title: Shake when it comes back
classes.goal: Listen for the first line each time it returns, and shake your hands when it does.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing when the same line comes back

classes.parentPrompt: Sway with your child; each time 'here we go looby loo' returns, shake your hands together.
classes.childAction: Sway with the song. Shake your hands when the line comes back.
classes.bridge: The first line is a friend who keeps coming back round the circle.

intro.caption: Shake when you hear it again
intro.parentCue: sway together, then shake hands on the repeat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing a line that repeats.

classes.title: Swing in the circle
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each big swinging beat while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: This song swings in twos: one, two, one, two

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each big swing. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each tap is one skip around the circle: skip, skip, skip.

intro.caption: One skip, one tap
intro.parentCue: say 'one, two' softly with the swings

games.caption: Here we go looby loo
games.parentCue: Tap two big taps with this line

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping a swinging beat.

classes.title: Find home note C
classes.goal: Find C by touch: it sits just left of the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the two black keys, then slide left onto C.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide left, and press C gently.
classes.bridge: The two black keys are a little hut; C waits just outside on the left.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: let your child touch them first, then find C

games.caption: C, C, C: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding one key by its landmark.

classes.title: Skip, skip, skip
classes.goal: Copy a pattern that skips over a key each time: C, E, G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping over one key each time, like hopscotch

classes.parentPrompt: Play C-E-G slowly, touching the skipped keys with a finger, then let your child copy.
classes.childAction: Listen, then play C, E, G, hopping over a key each time.
classes.bridge: C, E, G is hopscotch on the keys: hop over one, land, hop again.

intro.caption: Hop over one key
intro.parentCue: touch the skipped key so your child sees it

games.caption: Hop, hop: C, E, G
games.parentCue: Point to each landing key first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: copying a pattern that skips keys.

classes.title: Same jump, one step up
classes.goal: Hear the first line move one step higher, then copy both.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same shape, starting one key higher

classes.parentPrompt: Play the first jump, then the same jump one key to the right; let your child copy each.
classes.childAction: Copy the jump, then copy it again one key higher.
classes.bridge: The second line is the same game, played one step up the stairs.

intro.caption: Same jump, one step up
intro.parentCue: show each jump once, then let your child copy

games.caption: Jump from C: C, E, C
One step up: D, F, D
games.parentCue: Slide your child's hand one key right

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing the same pattern, one step higher.

classes.title: Wait for home C
classes.goal: Wait while the grown-up plays, then play C when it is your turn.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part, then joining in

classes.parentPrompt: Play your part, then nod to your child just before each C; smile while they wait.
classes.childAction: Wait for the nod, then press C.
classes.bridge: Like the circle game, everyone waits, then puts their hand in on C.

intro.caption: Wait, wait... hand in on C!
intro.parentCue: nod to your child when it is their turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a turn, then joining in.

classes.title: C or E? Pick one
classes.goal: Play two special notes, C and E, choosing the right one by listening.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound into one of two boxes

classes.parentPrompt: Point to C or E before each turn at first, then let your child choose.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose C or E, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: C is home, left of the black keys; E is one hop over, on the right.

intro.caption: Home C, or hop to E?
intro.parentCue: point first, then let your child choose alone

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two sounds apart and choosing one.

classes.title: Round the circle together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one swinging beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod the swing with your head; keep going if your child misses.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Holding hands in the circle, we all skip at the same speed.

intro.caption: Two players, one swing
intro.parentCue: nod the beat so your child can see it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Looby concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, end on the home note and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first line comes back, then the song ends home

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note together, then shake hands and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The circle goes round and round, then everyone stops at home on C.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
